critical_personality_distinctions.fact: Generalized Regression is Pro-only; its default observational-data method is Lasso. Unpenalized ML is a separate baseline fit. DOE-script defaults may instead use Forward Selection or Two Stage Forward Selection.

All five ZI families are offered:Binomial,Beta Binomial,Poisson,Negative Binomial,Gamma. Censoring is listed only for Normal,Exponential,Gamma,Weibull,Lognormal,Beta,Cox,so none of these ZI/ordinal families supports the censored-response launch contract.

Ordinal slopes are common across cumulative logits. Generalized Regression reports the first cutpoint and then successive cutpoint differences; the ordinary Ordinal Logistic personality reports cutpoints directly.

Do not transfer ordinary Ordinal Logistic default LR/profile-likelihood inference into Generalized Regression. GenReg parameter and covariance report pages say M-estimation sandwich; the ordinary personality has its own LR/Wald/profile options.

future_bounded_convention.definition: Expose model_based inverse-Hessian and explicitly named sandwich_HC0 separately. For replication frequencies w_i,use H=-sum_i w_i*d2logf_i and M=sum_i w_i*s_i*s_i^T,then H^-1*M*H^-1. Do not silently replace w_i by w_i^2. No finite-sample multiplier by default.
future_bounded_convention.limitation: This is a mathematically explicit implementation/oracle contract,not a verified reconstruction of JMP sandwich details. Keep that exact-parity item open.
future_bounded_convention.acceptance: Compare each covariance against independently differentiated original likelihood and individual-row replication. Do not infer covariance equivalence from matching point estimates.

support_notes.documented: Generalized Regression permits noninteger responses for its discrete distributions. ZIP and ZINB also explicitly permit a data set with no observed zeros.
support_notes.critical_oracle_difference: SciPy discrete pmf/logpmf rejects noninteger observations. Matching JMP fitting there needs an explicit Gamma-function likelihood continuation,not SciPy pmf. This does not create a normalized continuous probability distribution. Exact JMP fractional-count CDF/quantile and fractional-trial behavior remains unverified.
support_notes.boundary: pi belongs to[0,1]. pi=0 is the noninflated boundary; pi=1 makes base parameters unidentified. Zero-only data must not receive fabricated finite base estimates. sigma->0 for ZINB and delta->0 for ZI Beta Binomial are other lower-model limits.
support_notes.hurdle: ZIP/ZINB/ZIB/ZIBB are mixtures retaining base-component zeros,not zero-truncated hurdle models. ZI Gamma happens to separate zero/nonzero outcomes because Gamma has no atom at zero.

estimation.documented_options: Unpenalized ML baseline plus step-based and penalized GenReg techniques; observational default Lasso. SVEM Forward Selection/Lasso are unavailable for ZI Binomial and ZI Beta Binomial.
estimation.proposal: Fit all five unpenalized families before claiming any full row. Use stable logaddexp(log(pi),log1p(-pi)+logg0) for zero counts,log1p(-pi)+logg(y) otherwise; ZI Gamma zero contribution is log(pi). Shared auxiliary parameters are jointly estimated.
estimation.identification: Include exact pi=0 candidate as well as multiple interior starts. An unconstrained finite logit transform cannot attain the boundary. Report boundary status and withhold unjustified Wald inference; do not fake a positive floor. All-zero data,rank-deficient design,n=1 ZIB intercept confounding,and zero-dispersion suprema need explicit diagnostics. Local convergence never proves global optimality.

saved_prediction.documented: Saved mean prediction,distribution variance,linear predictor,CDF,mean SE/CI and simulation formulas are offered as applicable; saved mean uses the unconditional mixture mean.
saved_prediction.derived_quantile_proposal: Return0 when u<=pi; otherwise base_quantile((u-pi)/(1-pi)). A discrete base may still return0 above pi. For Gamma,positive result begins strictly above pi. Use left-continuous generalized inverse inf{y:F(y)>=u}.
saved_prediction.not_documented_as_JMP_save_option: A generic saved quantile formula is not listed in Save Columns; quantile output here is a proposed CPU convenience based on the distribution,not a claim of identical saved-column behavior.

bounded_api_proposal.uncertainty: Use named covariance_kind throughout saved predictions; retain joint auxiliary-parameter uncertainty. Do not apply a GLM covariance to the entire mixture.

jmp_report_parameterization.documented: First GenReg intercept is alpha1; later intercepts are alpha_j-alpha_(j-1),rather than the raw cutpoints reported by Ordinal Logistic personality.
jmp_report_parameterization.inference: There are K-1 finite cutpoints for Kcategories. The distribution-choice prose says an intercept for each level,but its p1..p(K-1) table and the cited ordinal equation fix the finite count.
jmp_report_parameterization.sign: Positive JMP beta raises lower-tail cumulative probabilities. Statsmodels OrderedModel uses F(cut-Xbeta); negate its fitted slope to compare JMP signs.
jmp_report_parameterization.no_intercept: The launch No Intercept option is unavailable for Ordinal Logistic. Thresholds play the intercept role; adding a free common intercept to predictors would be unidentified.
jmp_report_parameterization.censoring: Not in the launch censoring-supported family list.

ordinal_outcome.estimation: Joint multinomial likelihood sum_i w_i*log(p_(observed category,i)),not sum of K-1 independent binary likelihoods. ML baseline exists; default observational GenReg selection remains Lasso. SVEM Lasso/Forward Selection are unavailable for Ordinal Logistic.
ordinal_outcome.uncertainty: Use the GenReg sandwich research above. Cutpoint covariance must be linearly transformed into first-cutpoint/successive-difference report covariance; exponentiated internal gap parameters are not the displayed intercepts. Ordinary Ordinal Logistic profile-LR intervals are not automatically a GenReg contract.

saved_prediction.documented: For categorical responses Save Prediction Formula creates one probability per response level and the most-likely level.
saved_prediction.proposal: Expose ordered labels,cumulative probabilities,category probabilities,and most_likely. A tie rule must be explicitly specified; first ordered maximum is an API choice until JMP ties are checked.
saved_prediction.avoid: Do not return a numerical mean of category codes as a JMP prediction; numeric distances are semantically irrelevant. Per-category probability delta SE/CI can be offered as an explicitly named extension,but the exact JMP categorical saved mean-SE/CI construction was not established.

bounded_api_proposal.optimizer: Use ordered thresholds,for example alpha1 plus log positive gaps internally; report physical successive differences. Evaluate category log-probabilities with stable logistic differences and direct tails. No minimum-probability floor in likelihood.

intercept_only_zip_mle.derivation: 20observations,10positives,sum positive counts21. Solve lambda/(1-exp(-lambda))=2.1; pi=(.5-exp(-lambda))/(1-exp(-lambda)). Independent100-step scalar bisection; no Rust likelihood or optimization is copied.

intercept_only_ordinal_mle.derivation: Saturated intercept-only multinomial occurrence fractions; cutpoints=logit(cumulative fractions). Covariance derived by delta transform of multinomial covariance at N4; no JMP finite-sample correction is presumed.
metamorphic_checks: Replace labels by[3,100,999] in the same explicit order:probabilities/intercepts unchanged.
Use arbitrary reverse numeric labels in explicit order:only specified order matters.
Replicate frequencies and actual rows:point estimates and unadjusted sandwich agree; covariance scales inversely with replicated total.

ordinal_slope_sign_fixture.predicate: CDF(Y<=j) increases with x when JMP beta>0; statsmodels reference beta is-.7 for these same predictions.

required_future_oracle_layers: Closed-form/exact-rational prediction and intercept-only fits above before general optimizer tests.
Separate test-only SciPy optimizer with direct SciPy distributions and multiple independent starts; full likelihood,score,Hessian,individual-score meat,and transformed uncertainty.
Use statsmodels ZIP/ZINB with constant-only exog_infl and explicitly configured count intercept; ZINB p=2 and alpha=sigma. Do not compare default covariance without specifying its type.

Use statsmodels OrderedModel(distr=logit),no explicit/implicit predictor intercept; transform its threshold encoding to raw cuts and negate slopes before matching JMP convention. Default OrderedModel distribution is probit,which is not the target.
For ZIB/ZIBB use SciPy binom/betabinom with exact JMP-to(a,b) transform. For ZIG use gamma(shape=mu/sigma,scale=sigma); constant pi separates zero/nonzero likelihood.
mpmath80 direct likelihood derivatives and tail/quantile integrals as an independently implemented high-precision cross-check; preserve exact f64 inputs and save literal fixtures.
